data.spec: Implemented isolated RoomMessageWorkflow(conn,lookup_booking,lookup_contact,compose,sender=None). open_conflict(event_id,booking_id,requester_name)->conversation_id; await follow_up(conversation_id,event_id,text)->draft|clarification|cancelled|failed with exact fingerprint for draft; await dispatch(id,fingerprint)->sent|delivered|uncertain. Booking snapshots include room/time/owner/revision/simulation; model receives owner id/name but never number; recipients come from exact verified contact. Booking/contact changes invalidate proposal. Stable events bind input, attempt persisted before sender, uncertainty never retries. LiveRoomComposer() uses configured Anthropic for one strict tool-free structured draft. Only injected adapters; NO API route, voice routing, or real room calendar yet. Authorized live smoke test used personal WhatsApp Desktop UI; delivery read+reply verified. No Business/API setup claimed. docs/room-message-test.md covers use and limits.
